title: Casoli and Lucchetti, "Permanent-Transitory decomposition of cointegrated time series via Dynamic Factor Models, with an application to commodity prices" (Econometrics Journal 25(2), 2022): Section 4 commodity application
paper: Chiara Casoli and Riccardo Lucchetti, Permanent-Transitory decomposition of cointegrated time series via Dynamic Factor Models, with an application to commodity prices, The Econometrics Journal 25(2): 494-514, 2022
cost_basis: typical on-demand price for a 4 vCPU, 16 GB cloud machine

setup.cmd: printf 'pkg install DFM\npkg install staticfactor\n' > "$PWD/../pkgs.inp" && gretlcli -b "$PWD/../pkgs.inp"

scope_notes: Section 4 (the commodity application) only. The Monte Carlo in Section 3 has to be edited by hand for each table row (README: set the parameters in `main.inp`, then the file name in `stats.inp`), and its `extra` gretl package could not be downloaded here; it was not run.

The package commits no output files, so there is nothing for the generator to compare. The table printed by `part1.inp` is compared by hand with the paper's cointegration table, as set out in the protocol, and that comparison is listed under notes.
Plots written by `part2.inp` and `part3.inp` are not compared.
